answer_grammar.any: `abstain` is allowed anywhere; it scores nothing and is recorded as an abstention rather than as a wrong answer
answer_grammar.name_class: exactly one word: `level_data` if a board supplies it, `world_law` if no board can change it. There are only these two words, so something fixed by the language the manual is written in — rather than by this particular world — is still `world_law`: no board supplies it.
answer_grammar.optimal_action: exactly one action, written as it appears in `action_vocabulary`
answer_grammar.step_semantics: `<field>=<value>; …; rule=<name>` — every field listed in `state_fields` for that level, in any order, plus `rule`. A cell is written `(row,col)` and a true/false value `true` or `false`. The rule name must be one from `rule_vocabulary`.
